risks.description: Hook may not transition through parsing/running/complete with accurate counters during batched import.
risks.impact: Progress UI can show wrong status and completion values.

risks.description: Batch processing failure may stop import or miscount failed rows.
risks.impact: Partial imports can be reported as successful and hide row-level loss.

risks.description: CSV parser-level failure may not propagate to observable error state.
risks.impact: Users may not receive actionable import failure feedback.

risks.description: Reset/cancel may not cancel in-flight import side effects.
risks.impact: Canceled imports can still mutate state after user cancellation.

scenarios.name: parsing to running to complete with progress updates
scenarios.preconditions: usePapaParse is mounted with batchSize=2 and deterministic processBatch Promises.
scenarios.stimulus: Trigger parseCsv, then resolve first and second batch in order.
scenarios.oracle: State moves parsing->running->complete, counts are updated, and remainingTime is computed during running then cleared at completion.
scenarios.isolation: papaparse.parse is mocked and Date.now is stubbed deterministically.

scenarios.name: batch failure increments errorCount and import continues
scenarios.preconditions: usePapaParse is mounted with two deterministic batches.
scenarios.stimulus: Reject first processBatch Promise, then resolve second Promise.
scenarios.oracle: errorCount increases by failed batch size, second batch still executes, and final state is complete.
scenarios.isolation: papaparse.parse and console.error are mocked; no timers or sleeps.

scenarios.name: parser error transitions to error state
scenarios.preconditions: usePapaParse is mounted and parse options are captured from mocked papaparse.
scenarios.stimulus: Invoke parser error callback with a concrete Error.
scenarios.oracle: Hook state becomes error and processBatch is never called.

scenarios.name: reset cancels in-flight import
scenarios.preconditions: usePapaParse is running with one unresolved processBatch Promise.
scenarios.stimulus: Trigger reset before batch Promise resolves, then resolve the Promise.
scenarios.oracle: State returns to idle and remains idle after the previously in-flight Promise resolves.
scenarios.isolation: Promise resolution is controlled manually; no fixed sleeps are used.
